item.text:
The fault is in [ValidateFiles](/app/internal/cue/validate.go:111). It records only each CUE error’s generic message and first input position, discarding the field path and any other positions. [Error](/app/internal/cue/validate.go:60) has no field path to return. With three misspelled keys, JSON output reported three identical `field not allowed` errors at line 7, column 8, although the keys were on lines 2–4. The command exited with status 1.

The fix should retain each error’s field path, locate the offending key in the original YAML, and return every finding through a structured `Result`. The text and JSON formatters should use that result; the JSON branch currently writes to `os.Stdout` instead of its supplied writer ([validate.go](/app/internal/cue/validate.go:83)). A `rollout: 110` error was reported at the value’s location, but its message omitted the field path. Whether CUE alone exposes the exact key position for unknown fields remains to be checked.

The existing tests pass, but cover only one raw rollout error. I recorded the findings in [.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md). No project source or tests were changed, as required by the fault-localization role.
